pli-tv-pvr1.5:1.1: methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevantassa āpattiyo channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ katīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhanti.
pli-tv-pvr1.5:1.3: kāyato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhanti na vācato. --la--
pli-tv-pvr1.5:2.1: anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake . . . karontassa āpatti channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ katīhi . . .
pli-tv-pvr1.5:2.3: kāyato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhāti na vācato.
